title: NPM Security for React
description: Keep your React frontend dependencies safe and up to date.

data.text:
**NPM Security**

React apps rely heavily on npm packages. Each dependency is code you did not write but will execute in users' browsers.

items: Audit lock files for drift regularly

data.title: NPM Audit Workflow
data.content:
npm audit                    # Review vulnerabilities
npm audit fix               # Patch automatically
npm audit fix --force       # Accept breaking changes (careful)
npm audit --json > report.json

items: Review UI library updates for XSS regressions
Check for prototype pollution in utility libraries
Minify and tree-shake unused code in production

data.title: Audit Fatigue
data.text: npm audit can report thousands of issues. Focus on high-severity, reachable vulnerabilities first.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Commit lock files for reproducible installs
Review React dependencies for XSS risks
data.takeaway: Frontend dependencies are just as risky as backend ones.
